name: IntentFence Policy Agent
description: Guards a proposed agent action against spend, scope, data-retention, and human-approval constraints.

skills.name: Agent action policy gate
skills.description: Return safe_to_proceed, needs_review, or denied before an autonomous action reaches the downstream tool.
examples: Check whether did:web:crew-07 may book a 428.20 USD flight under a 500 USD ceiling.
